messages:
Finn Harper: Hey folks — Finn here, starting today on DevEx. Hybrid (W/F remote). I fold a bike and bring microgreen samples to desperate friends. Quick q: best quick lunch options near the office? Also curious who runs the plant swap. :seedling:
Maya Sato: welcome @Finn! Pho alley for speed, rooftop for sunshine. We do a plant swap on Fridays — Keiko coordinates. :smile:
Keiko Tanaka: that would be me! :wave: Microgreens are encouraged. Pro tip: please label trays with your name + sow date, otherwise they mysteriously get adopted. Also fridge rule: label everything or beware the curry purge. :grimacing:
Ari Park: hey hey — welcome! Office espresso prefers medium grind. If you want a tour of the glorious under-desk cable maze I9m available. We have a 15-min lunchtime walk route along the river that9s great for unplugging. :bicyclist:
Sam (People Ops): Hi Finn — added you to the Monday lunch rota and the plant-swap calendar. DM me if you need badge, parking, or chair adjustments. :handshake:
Finn Harper: amazing, thanks. I9ll bring a tiny microgreen tasting demo next Wednesday at 12:30 with a one-sheet on care. Who9s up for a short walk after lunch? I can fold the bike and show the riverside loop.
welcome-bot: Finn Harper joined #new-hires — welcome message sent.
Keiko Tanaka: river walk + swap on Friday? Count me in. Also: what desk snacks are people hoarding? I have emergency wasabi peas.
Ari Park: granola bars, instant oats, and a very suspicious jar of coffee grounds. :coffee:
Maya Sato: dried mango for life. :mango:
Sam (People Ops): quick reminder: second-Monday onboarding Q&A if you haven9t been invited. Welcome again, Finn!
Finn Harper: thanks all — see you Friday 12:45 by reception. Microgreen samples + labels incoming!
